title: Ruiz-Garcia et al. 2024 - Dynamical resonances in PHANGS galaxies: bar corotation catalogue
purpose: Gates S2 selection lock: R_CR + uncertainty, bar radius, pattern speed, quality flags.

provenance.zenodo_doi_field_in_record: 10.1051/0004-6361/xxxxxxx (placeholder left by the authors in the Zenodo metadata)
provenance.data_availability_statement: Supplementary material is available at: https://zenodo.org/records/13898598
provenance.note_on_extraction: The Zenodo record contains ONLY a 26 MB PDF appendix - no machine-readable table. The CSVs here were parsed from the arXiv e-print LaTeX source (AAmain.tex longtables), which carries the identical published table content in text form.

contents.ruizgarcia2024_tableA1_phangs_sample.csv: Table A.1 - full PHANGS sample (74 galaxies): RA, Dec, PA, incl, distance (with errors), rotation sense, bar flag, CO coverage radii.
contents.ruizgarcia2024_tableA2_corotation.csv: Table A.2 - THE CATALOGUE: 46 barred galaxies with R_CR (kpc) + uncertainty, R_bar (kpc), ratio R = R_CR/R_bar, quality flag QF, nominal ICA map. 38 have a determined R_CR.
contents.ruizgarcia2024_tableA3_pattern_speed_res: Table A.3 - pattern speed Omega_p (km/s/kpc) and Lindblad resonances iILR / oILR / OLR (kpc), with errors. 28 galaxies have Omega_p, 16 an OLR, 18 an oILR, 6 an iILR.
contents.parse_tables.py: The parser, for bit-exact reproduction from the arXiv source.

column_notes.errors: err_lo / err_hi are separate columns. Symmetric errors have err_lo == err_hi. 8 rows in Table A.3 carry genuinely asymmetric errors, preserved as published.
column_notes.QF: Quality flag 1 (best) to 3 (worst), carrying the published dagger annotations verbatim: '1','2','2^dagger','2^ddagger','3','3^dagger'. The paper's headline R = 1.12 +/- 0.39 EXCLUDES QF=3; that subset is exactly the 20 rows whose QF starts with 1 or 2.
column_notes.empty_cells: An empty cell means the published table printed '...' (not determined). Never treat as zero.

flags_for_the_thread: Table A.1 NGC 1566 PA cell contains a typo in the published LaTeX source: '214.{\pm 4.1} 7' - the trailing digit of 214.7 sits outside the error brace. Reassembled to PA = 214.7 +/- 4.1 and flagged in the parse_note column. No other row needed repair.

Table A.3 NGC 5068 lists OLR = 0.7 (+0.0/-0.4) kpc with iILR and oILR both undetermined. That OLR is SMALLER than the same galaxy's R_CR = 1.9 kpc. Delivered verbatim as published - not corrected, not dropped. Treat with suspicion before use.
All three MHONGOOSE fleet targets are in the catalogue and ALL THREE carry QF = 3^dagger, the lowest-confidence tier.
